text.en: This Order shall be cited as the Minor Offences Act (Amendment) Order, of section 2 of Chapter 30.

Section 2 of the Minor Offences Act, in this Order referred to as the principal amended by inserting the following new definition immediately after the or near any public road" - means the Minister of Home Affairs; ". of section 12.

Section 12 of the principal Act is amended in subsection ( 1) - (a} by inserting ", Municipal Inspector, Inspector of Health, any District and any person authorised by him, the Director General of Public Works and any person authorised by him, and the Director of Environment, Parks and and any person authorised by him" immediately after "officer" where that word appears four lines from the end; {b) by adding "and to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 3 months" after "$3,000". of new section 32A.

The Act is amended by inserting immediately after section 32 the following new section 32A - to investigate. 32A. Any person authorised by name or by office by the Minister by in the Gazette, in relation to any offence under section 12 or to 1st. NOVEMBER, 2006 any offence under this Act shall have the power to investigate the commission of an offence under this Act or any rules made thereunder.". Made this 18th. day of Ramadan, 1427 Hijriah corresponding to the 11th. day of October, 2006 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
